notes.subject: ruak
notes.rationale: רוח i wanpela tok — ruak; Inglis 'spirit' o 'wind' tasol i no wanpela tok.

notes.subject: ויאמר
notes.rationale: Tupela ויאמר — namba wan em i tok bilong ruak, namba tu em i tok bilong Yahwe; Inglis i kliautim long 'And he/He said', Tok Pisin i putim nem.

notes.subject: תפתה
notes.rationale: פתה i min 'pulim i go long giaman / trim'; ol tanim tok i stap long 'entice', 'persuade', 'deceive'.

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Hibru i no tok em i bin tokim; Tok Pisin i nidim subjek.

translation: Na ⟨em⟩ i tok: Bai mi go ausait, na bai mi kamap ruak bilong tok giaman long maus bilong olgeta profet bilong en. Na Yahwe i tok: Bai yu pulim em i go long tok giaman, na bai yu inap; go ausait na wokim olsem.

tokens.gloss: Bai yu pulim em i go long tok giaman
